name: What is a garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage conversion transforms an existing garage space into a new, functional living area. This can include converting it into an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), a home office, an extra bedroom, a gym, or a studio. The process involves structural modifications, insulation, plumbing, electrical work, and finishes to make the space habitable and integrated with your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion transforms an existing garage into a new, functional living space like an ADU, office, or bedroom.
